name: agentic-workflow
purpose: Autonomous design, orchestration, validation, and execution of multi-step AI agent workflows across Research, Planning, and Implementation
baseline_failure: Without guidance, AI agents produce incomplete plans, skip physical deliverable creation, mutate shared state concurrently, perform untested speculative edits, and fail to enforce deterministic quality gates across heterogeneous hosts

negative: write a simple one-line bash script
fix this single typo in README

outputs: Stage deliverables verified on disk (L0-L2 quality gates)
Audit trace records in .traces and ledger
invariants: Absolute Criterion 1: Quality of the final deliverable strictly overrides speed and token costs
Absolute Criterion 2: Single-file SOT (state.yaml) with single-writer permission model
Absolute Criterion 3: Code Change Protocol (CCP) with 4 Coding Anchor Points (CAP-1~4)
Zero unexecuted assertions or fake mock approvals

workflow.action: Research & intelligence gathering with domain expertise delegation
workflow.why: Prevents building upon flawed or noisy requirements

workflow.action: Architecture and verifiable plan formulation in SOT state.yaml
workflow.why: Prevents architectural divergence and state desynchronization

workflow.action: Production implementation with surgical diffs and circuit breaker monitoring
workflow.why: Prevents speculative thrashing and scope bloat

workflow.action: 4-layer quality gate verification (L0 Anti-Skip, L1 Semantic Gate, L1.5 pACS, L2 Adversarial Review)
workflow.why: Guarantees 100% functional goal achievement and deliverable integrity

evals.prompt: Design and execute an autonomous 3-stage pipeline for user onboarding
expected: L0 anti-skip verification passes for all deliverables
